messages:
camille: FYI — acme-corp hits a bunch of 401s starting ~09:12 UTC after our nightly secret sweep. They say SDKs started failing. Watching latency climb too.
josh: Can you drop the request id / sample curl and response headers?
camille: curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXXX" https://api.redwood.com/v1/predict
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
< x-request-id: req_0a1b2c
< www-authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token"
camille: Also seeing our edge proxy return 403 -> downstream returned 401 in some logs. Not consistent across regions :eu-west still ok :us-east failing.
maria: I see a Vault revocation event at 2026-03-16T09:11:50Z for secret path secret/data/apikeys/acme-corp. Rotation job id rot-2026-0316-211 fired at 09:10. Did we enable immediate revoke?
eng-sre-bot: alert: rotation-job rot-2026-0316-211 completed (status=success) | affected=acme-corp | changed_keys=1
alex: Possible stale env var / sidecar cache. If the sidecar hasn't picked up the new file/k8s secret volume, some pods will keep old key. Also CDN edge caches auth headers for 60s, but not long enough to explain multi-hour drift.
josh: Is KMS rewrap in place? If we rewrapped to a new key id, some AWS Lambda or edge instances might still decrypt with prior CMK alias.
maria: Vault audit shows rewrap -> new ciphertext blob, TTL=0, and then immediately a delete on the old version. No lease extension. That could produce a short window where clients with rotated key can't get unsealed secret if the sidecar fetch fails.
camille: Repro steps I ran locally to mimic: 1) create secret v1 in vault 2) simulate rotation (write v2 + delete v1) 3) app reads cached file -> 401. Commands:
  vault kv put secret/apikeys/acme-corp value=sk_test_v2
  kubectl exec -it svc/acme-api -- cat /etc/secrets/apikey
  # still shows sk_test_v1 until sidecar restart
alex: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) trigger rolling restart of sidecars in affected nodepools (eu & us-east) 2) re-enable lease grace window on rotation job (30s) 3) temporarily un-delete old secret version in Vault so clients can fallback.
maria: I can undelete the old version now. Doing it.
camille: I'll notify acme-corp support and open a ticket. :eyes:
eng-sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-3145 | owner=alex | priority=P1
josh: Good catch. After we stabilize, let's add a postmortem and adjust rotation to write new secret and keep old version undeleted for N minutes.
alex: I'll start sidecar rolling restart in us-east now (kubectl rollout restart ds/secret-sidecar -n prod --selector=region=us-east). ETA ~4m. :thumbsup:
maria: Old version restored. Monitoring logs for 401 counts.
camille: Customer confirms SDK auth recovered for some clients. Still seeing a handful of failures tied to long-lived connections. We'll keep on it and post updates.
camille: ACTIONS: alex -> sidecar restart/rollback alias, maria -> rotation job config + undelete, josh -> postmortem draft, camille -> customer comms. Closing loop here later.
